title: Resource selection: no engine runs the synchronous section at a microtask checkpoint
body:
[await a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#await-a-stable-state) is defined as "queue a microtask", so step 4 of the [resource selection algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-media-load-algorithm) means the synchronous section — including step 12, which sets `networkState` to `NETWORK_LOADING` — runs at the next microtask checkpoint.

Firefox Nightly, Chrome Canary and Safari TP all appear to run it in a task instead.

[demo](https://software.hixie.ch/utilities/js/live-dom-viewer/?%3C!DOCTYPE%20html%3E%0A%3Cscript%3E%0Afunction%20state%28v%29%20%7B%0A%20%20return%20%5B'EMPTY'%2C%20'IDLE'%2C%20'LOADING'%2C%20'NO_SOURCE'%5D%5Bv.networkState%5D%20%2B%20'%20%2F%20'%20%2B%20%28v.currentSrc.split%28'%2F'%29.pop%28%29%20%7C%7C%20'%22%22'%29%3B%0A%7D%0A%3C%2Fscript%3E%0A%3Cvideo%20id%3D%22v%22%3E%3Csource%3E%3Csource%20src%3D%22delayed-image%22%3E%3C%2Fvideo%3E%0A%3Cscript%3E%0Aconst%20v%20%3D%20document.getElementById%28'v'%29%3B%0Aw%28'inline%20script%3A%20'%20%2B%20state%28v%29%29%3B%0APromise.resolve%28%29.then%28%28%29%20%3D%3E%20w%28'microtask%3A%20%20%20%20%20'%20%2B%20state%28v%29%29%29%3B%0AsetTimeout%28%28%29%20%3D%3E%20w%28'setTimeout%280%29%3A%20'%20%2B%20state%28v%29%29%2C%200%29%3B%0A%3C%2Fscript%3E%0A): `<video><source><source src=delayed-image></video>` followed by an inline script.

| | inline script | microtask | `setTimeout(0)` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Firefox Nightly | `NO_SOURCE / ""` | `NO_SOURCE / ""` | `LOADING / ""` |
| Chrome Canary | `NO_SOURCE / ""` | `NO_SOURCE / ""` | `LOADING / delayed-image` |
| Safari TP | `NO_SOURCE / ""` | `NO_SOURCE / ""` | `LOADING / delayed-image` |

Expected is `LOADING / delayed-image` already at the inline script, since the parser [performs a microtask checkpoint](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#parsing-main-incdata) at `</script>`.

The parser isn't the cause. `document.createElement('video')` + `appendChild(source)` from a script gives the same result in each of them ([demo](https://software.hixie.ch/utilities/js/live-dom-viewer/?%3C!DOCTYPE%20html%3E%0A%3Cscript%3E%0Afunction%20state%28v%29%20%7B%0A%20%20return%20%5B'EMPTY'%2C%20'IDLE'%2C%20'LOADING'%2C%20'NO_SOURCE'%5D%5Bv.networkState%5D%20%2B%20'%20%2F%20'%20%2B%20%28v.currentSrc.split%28'%2F'%29.pop%28%29%20%7C%7C%20'%22%22'%29%3B%0A%7D%0Aconst%20v%20%3D%20document.createElement%28'video'%29%3B%0Aconst%20source%20%3D%20document.createElement%28'source'%29%3B%0Asource.src%20%3D%20'delayed-image'%3B%0Av.appendChild%28source%29%3B%20%2F%2F%20invokes%20the%20resource%20selection%20algorithm%0Aw%28'sync%3A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20'%20%2B%20state%28v%29%29%3B%0APromise.resolve%28%29%0A%20%20.then%28%28%29%20%3D%3E%20w%28'microtask%201%3A%20%20%20'%20%2B%20state%28v%29%29%29%0A%20%20.then%28%28%29%20%3D%3E%20w%28'microtask%202%3A%20%20%20'%20%2B%20state%28v%29%29%29%3B%0AsetTimeout%28%28%29%20%3D%3E%20w%28'setTimeout%280%29%3A%20'%20%2B%20state%28v%29%29%2C%200%29%3B%0A%3C%2Fscript%3E%0A)):

```
sync:          NO_SOURCE / ""
microtask 1:   NO_SOURCE / ""
microtask 2:   NO_SOURCE / ""
setTimeout(0): LOADING / delayed-image
```

This is long-standing: `resource-selection-invoke-insert-source-networkState.html` has asserted `NETWORK_LOADING` since it was written and fails in each of them.

(I ran into it writing tests for #12511 in web-platform-tests/wpt#60466.)
